messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — infra hit on the storage shard means March milestone needs a small reshuffle. Proposal: keep core inference runtime + SLOs for MVP, move non-blocking tenant encryption UI and admin UX to v1.
Alex: How big is the UI work? can we land behind a flag and still ship MVP on time?
Maya: ~2 devs x 2 sprints for the full admin flows. Santiago suggested flagging — that feels like the safest path.
Santiago: Yep — ship the backend API and KMS integration for tenants in MVP, UI behind feature_flag:tenant_encryption_ui. Enable for pilot customers only.
Jen: We need clear launch criteria then — MVP = inference runtime stable at p95 < 250ms, error rate <0.5%, and pilot customers able to opt-in to tenant encryption via API.
Tom (QA): If UI is behind a flag, we still need e2e tests for the API surface and a small smoke test for the flag toggle. Can we add that to regression?
Alex: Adding API tests is fine. Frontend smoke can be a single playwright job that runs only when flag=true.
Maya: Action: Alex to implement flag + API, Tom to add tests, Santiago to document rollout plan and telemetry. Jen will own criteria gating.
Oliver (release-bot): deploy-bot: new branch build started for feature/tenant-flag at 1766667000 — CI queued :rocket:
Santiago: Rollout plan draft: 1) deploy backend + API off by default, 2) enable flag for internal QA, 3) enable for 2 pilot customers (5% traffic each), 4) monitor errors & latency for 72h, 5) expand to 25% if stable.
Maya: Good. Also add a fallback: if error spikes >0.5% or p95 regresses by >15% vs baseline, flip flag off and failover to unencrypted UX.
Jen: Agree. We should also schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10am to confirm readiness and update roadmap milestones.
Alex: FYI — if we move the admin UX to v1, we free up ~8 dev-weeks this cycle to harden caching and batching (big win for cost).
Tom (QA): Noted — prioritize caching tests too.
Maya: Consensus: move admin UX to v1, keep backend and API in MVP behind a flag, rollout per Santiago's plan, and hold a quick sync tomorrow 10am. I'll update the milestone tracker and notify stakeholders.
Jen: I'll update the launch criteria doc and post in #product after sync. :white_check_mark:
